title: Eric Kang · Field Notes
tagline: Lessons learned firsthand: from engineering to leadership, building with AI, and the timeless wisdom of Eastern philosophy.
description: Practical notes on three things I have learned by doing: moving from engineering into leadership, building AI-enabled services and agentic workflows, and applying lessons from Eastern philosophy to learning, growth, decision-making and living well.

author.name: Eric Kang
author.jobTitle: Knowledge management and AI strategy leader
author.bio: Started out as an electrical engineer at Motorola and went on to lead a design team there. Now works on knowledge management, business development and AI strategy across Hong Kong, Malaysia and mainland China.
about: I lead knowledge management, corporate affairs and business development at a data technology company, and help shape its AI strategy across Hong Kong, Malaysia and mainland China.

I hold a BSEE from Southern Illinois University and an MBA from HKUST. I started my career as an electrical engineer at Motorola and went on to lead a design team there. Since then I have worked across business development, quality, data production and operations.

Here I write about what I have learned firsthand, from moving out of engineering into leadership to building AI-enabled services and agentic workflows. I also write about Eastern philosophy and the timeless lessons it offers anyone on learning, growth, decision-making and living well.
education: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
